test_name: Hands stretch to random place after app focus loss - cfa48138-87d8-4c43-b97f-1e6745d4e6bb
summary: Inconclusive because the fix only runs on a real Meta headset, and the cloud editor has none, so nobody could press the Meta button to test it. When the game loses focus, the Meta SDK moves both hands to the middle of the play area on the floor. Single-player pauses the game, but multiplayer keeps running, so the mech arms stretch to that spot. The fix keeps both hands at their last position until focus comes back; it compiles cleanly.
